qualification.broad_upgrade: Development close CAGR >= baseline, drawdown at least 1pp smaller; all common stress/block gates pass.
qualification.risk_efficiency: Development close CAGR >= 95% baseline and drawdown <= 90% baseline; all common stress/block gates pass.
qualification.common: Each close11bp and lag1_11bp CAGR >= 95% baseline and drawdown <= baseline; each of three development block CAGRs >= baseline minus 5pp in both stresses.
qualification.validation: 2024-25 close and both stress CAGRs >= baseline minus 3pp, drawdown <= baseline plus 2pp. Validation can veto frozen nomination, never replace it.
qualification.nomination: Prefer broad_upgrade, then risk_efficiency. Rank passing candidates by worst stress-block CAGR excess, then close CAGR, then fewer switches. No passing candidate means no qualified upgrade.
qualification.diagnostic: If no qualification, separately show highest relative close Calmar among selectable candidates; never call it qualified.

semantics.crash_weight: Fixed risk/cash units from crash entry until next target change; no daily rebalance.
semantics.cash_buffer: Fallback only: existing risk asset eligible at MOM20 >= 0; new one requires MOM20 > 2%; else cash. Regular entrants/crash rules retained.
semantics.defensive: 512890 may participate in bearish normal competition and fallback; retain original stock classification for crash logic.
semantics.costs: Legacy-compatible turnover at pre-fee NAV, not exact post-fee self-financing transaction costs.

constraints: No parameter search beyond these twelve predefined specifications.
All historical periods have previously been seen/researched; no clean out-of-sample claim.
Postrelease behavior informed hypotheses; its replay is diagnostic, not independent validation.
Latest completed closes only; no synthetic 14:50 fills or opening-price claim.
No new universe members, leverage, or short positions.
